in_arabic.name: أزواج
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الزواج، يعني الاتحاد أو التزاوج، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة: 'وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا'، يشير إلى الزوجية والتناسخ في الكون، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام كقيمة اجتماعية ودينية.

in_urdu.name: ازواج
in_urdu.meaning: دوستیاں یا جوڑے یا شادی شدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ازواج کا مطلب ہے جوڑے یا دوستیاں، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں شادی اور زوجیت کی علامت ہے، عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، اور جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے ثقافتی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: अزوज
in_hindi.long_meaning: अزوज नाम का अर्थ है जोड़े याคู่, यह इस्लामी परंपरा में विवाह और साथी की प्रतीक है, इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं, और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका विशेष महत्व है।

in_english.name: Azwaaj
in_english.long_meaning: Azwaaj is derived from the Arabic root 'Z-W-J', meaning couples, spouses, or marriage. It is mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-Baqarah: 'And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates'), signifying companionship and unity. The name holds significant spiritual and social importance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing harmony and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azwaaj holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic community as it symbolizes the deep bond of love, respect, and commitment shared by a married couple. In Islamic tradition, marriage is considered a sacred union that (ideally) lasts a lifetime. The term "azwaaj" underlines the importance of this institution and encourages couple bonding.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Azwaaj serves as a reminder that every individual is incomplete without a partner to complement and complete their journey in life. It reinforces the message of unity, love, and companionship in both this world and the hereafter. In Islamic teachings, marriage is seen as a divine institution created for the happiness of the couple and for the procreation of offspring, and Azwaaj is a beautiful representation of this ideal partnership.
